alt: An animated Reel: Conductor, a synthetic robot presenter with a clock for a face, introduces the Sovereign Website agents while a board above lights up each role in turn: conductor, factory, sites, design, security, hub, observability, library, Instagram and studio, each with its own key, inside a policy.
caption:
Meet the team.

Conductor, one of our synthetic presenters, introduces the AI agents behind Sovereign Website, each with one job: a conductor that plans the work, a factory that turns each request into a repository and a live site, agents for sites, design and security, a hub that maps every site, observability for the traffic, and a library for what we learn. On this account, one agent prepares the posts and a studio agent makes the videos.

Every agent signs its work with its own key, inside a policy that says what it may touch. Dinis Cruz decides what we work on.

See the sites we have built at hub.sovereignweb.site

The presenter is made by code and the voice is AI-generated.

#SovereignWebsite #AIagents #OwnYourWebsite
